title: MCSpotify
description: The mod is focused on the Spotify + Minecraft connection
body:
# MCSpotify

Bring full Spotify control directly into Minecraft!

**MCSpotify** is a lightweight and intuitive mod that allows you to control your Spotify playback without leaving the game. Whether you're building, exploring, mining, or fighting mobs, your music is always just a click away.

## Features

### 🎵 HUD Overlay

Display information about the currently playing track directly on your screen.

### ⏯️ Play & Pause

Control music playback instantly without switching to Spotify or leaving Minecraft.

### ⏭️ Track Navigation

Skip to the next song or return to the previous one directly from within the game.

### 🔊 Volume Control

Adjust Spotify volume without minimizing Minecraft.

## Supported Version

* Minecraft **1.21.11**

## Why MCSpotify?

MCSpotify is designed for players who want a seamless music experience while playing Minecraft. The mod integrates Spotify controls directly into the game, allowing you to manage your music without interrupting gameplay.

Stay immersed in your world while keeping complete control over your soundtrack.

### Key Benefits

* Simple and easy-to-use interface
* Real-time track information
* In-game Spotify controls
* Lightweight and performance-friendly
* No need to switch between applications

Enjoy your favorite music while playing Minecraft with **MCSpotify**.
